summary: #smallpoems wheel turning but eyes can not wake up formless thoughts reflection of matter A rebel child, mama I tried but ideas busted on this cloudy day No masterpiece could I ever paint with star as my desire Not after chasing reality in Hunter's Dark
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
wheel turning
but eyes can not wake up
formless thoughts
reflection of matter
A rebel child, mama I tried
but ideas busted
on this
cloudy day
No masterpiece could I ever paint with
star as my desire
Not after chasing reality
in Hunter's
Dark
